title: Regional college-affordability explainers
context: The college-010 explorer presents national College Scorecard data. Per-region slices (by state, metro area, or other geographic unit) make affordability and outcome data more actionable for local students, families, and counsellors — while maintaining the same institution-level, no-ranking, not-advice approach. Region selection follows the region rubric (regionrubric-006).
objective: Build regional college-affordability explainers (per-state or per-metro slices of the College Scorecard) extending the college-010 module, with no composite ranking and explicit 'not advice' framing.
acceptanceCriteria: Gate-003 PASS per region: College Scorecard = US government public domain; output CC-BY-4.0; institution-level data only, no person-level data; committed gate artifact.
Each regional slice presents affordability and outcomes without a single composite 'best' ranking and without causal claims; explicit 'not advice' + data limits displayed.
Methodology Card per region: data dictionary version, transforms, vintage, and an explicit 'does NOT claim' list (no ranking-as-advice, no causation).
Figures reproduce in CI from committed code + College Scorecard snapshot; built on the shared toolkit (toolkit-002) and the college-010 module.
Methodology+Stats, Domain (college-access practitioner), License, and Accessibility reviewer sign-offs obtained per region.
output: Regional college-affordability explainers (per-region committed static tools + plain-language content + Methodology Cards + gate artifacts + accessibility sign-offs).
